summary: Resolved catalog identity 66, the resumed Fifth Sunday after the Epiphany (roman-1962, II class, green), for Sunday 8 November 2026. Sources: the 1962 typical edition's own page images (DOMINICA QUINTA quae superfuit post Epiphaniam, printed pp. 420-421, nos. 1749-1758), RG 18 b (26 Sundays after Pentecost put the Fifth at slot 24 and omit the Fourth), RGMR 298 (chants from the Twenty-third Sunday; orations and lessons proper), the November Calendarium, computation, and two live dated Ordos (FSSP France, ICRSP France), which agree. The calendar commemoration of the Four Crowned Martyrs is excluded at every Mass by RG 111 b / RGMR 434 b. research/context.md records the publication mode, the complete ten-element inventory with loci, the Ordinary's text-bearing parts, the word-level divergences from the Clementine Vulgate, the lawful Latin and English routes, and the remaining source plan. main.tex holds only the scaffold comment.
